entry.title: Lattice moments and quantum designs
entry.summary:
We show that the ensemble of unimodular Gottesman$-$Kitaev$-$Preskill distributions fails to form a rigged quantum $3$-design and quantify the replica defect that determines this failure. This is established by rederiving a second moment formula for symplectic lattices in a self-contained manner.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #quantum-computing #post-quantum

entry.title: Multiparticle quantum walks in a dipole-conserving Bose–Hubbard model
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03512-z Strong potential gradients can localize individual particles, but interactions can still generate collective motion. An experiment with ultracold atoms in a tilted lattice now shows this collective motion by tracking mobile bound states of fractons.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #post-quantum
